initialScene.authoredChanges: Six clear/graded company pads,16m-wide game road cores and reconstructed physical deck/culvert surfaces, two graded real-reference runways. All ownership/fronts/use fictional.
initialScene.notCertified: All-route native tank/aircraft gameplay and whole-world performance not yet tested; no current military deployment or attack plan.

hydroProof.source: Primary cached OSM body/geometry extracts; mapped polygon footprint observed, stream widths conservative game authoring.

gradingProof.method: Balanced Lipschitz cut/fill fit to planningDSM+0.5m:5% source-edge grade,2.5% at wet crossings/near-overlapping surfaces, minimum water+3m deck-vertex floor. Surface-only adjacency never adds navigation links. Explicit fictional construction, not surveyed pavement.
